verdict.rationale: Canny's changelog product (canny-docs-8) is documented as a way to announce shipped updates to customers, and the dev docs probe references a customizable widget, but the evidence pack never explicitly confirms an embeddable changelog widget with SDK/snippet instructions the way it does for the feedback widget. missing for 10: explicit embed/snippet docs for the changelog widget, customization options, and independent confirmation of embedding on third-party sites.
